entities.name: Groth Jonar
entities.description: Tall Balduvian orc warrior, clansmaster and general of the orc armies.

entities.name: Elkan
entities.description: Balduvian mage assigned with Jonar who was killed by him.

entities.name: Kjeldorans
entities.description: Enemy of the Balduvians, whose knights fought at Balesh Pass.

entities.name: Flarg goblins
entities.description: Goblins recruited by Elkan and sacrificed by Jonar.

entities.name: Balesh Pass
entities.description: Site of a battle between Balduvians and Kjeldorans.

entities.name: Balduvia
entities.description: Homeland of Groth Jonar's orc clans.

events.summary: Elkan recruited Flarg goblins for the battle of Balesh Pass, against Jonar's protests.
events.quote: Elkan recruited goblins of the Flarg to participate in the battle of Balesh Pass

events.summary: Angered by Elkan's scheme, Jonar trapped the goblins as a distraction and attacked Kjeldor's knights, who suffered heavy losses and retreated.
events.quote: Jonar locked the goblins in a trap between allies and enemies

events.summary: Jonar stabbed Elkan in the belly, killing him, and let the remaining knights retreat, claiming their battle standard.
events.quote: Jonar responded by stabbing Elkan in the belly with his sword, killing him.

relations.quote: Jonar responded by stabbing Elkan in the belly with his sword, killing him.
